content.short: Sperax is a DeFi protocol on Arbitrum that issues USDs, a fully collateralized and auto-yielding stablecoin.
content.description: Sperax is a leading decentralized finance protocol built natively on the Arbitrum network, known for its innovative stablecoin, USDs. Unlike traditional assets that require manual staking, USDs is 'auto-yielding,' meaning holders earn returns automatically in their wallets by simply holding the token. The protocol maintains a 100% collateralization ratio for USDs, investing the underlying assets into a curated selection of low-risk DeFi strategies. Governed by the SPA token, the protocol features a robust governance model where stakers receive veSPA to vote on yield strategies.
content.meta: Sperax provides the auto-yielding USDs stablecoin and decentralized asset management on Arbitrum. Discover Sperax on the Lancers Web3 Explorer.
